# PixelLab Ltd.

> PixelLab Ltd. is a game studio in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It builds real-time multiplayer Bengali board games (16 Guti, Sholo Guti Pro) and Adda, a live streaming and social app, all running on its own real-time social multiplayer SDK.

## Products

- [16 Guti Game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixellab.bead.online.board.game): The classic Bengali strategy board game (16 beads, two sides). Play online against real opponents or offline against a bot. Android, 10K+ downloads, rated 4.7.
- [16 Guti: Sholo Guti Pro](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixellab.shologuti.offline.bead16.damro): Premium Sholo Guti with four game modes, VIP rooms and ranked play. Android, 100K+ downloads, rated 4.1.
- [Adda — Live Stream & Chat](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixellab.adda.live): Social app to discover creators, go live and browse verified talent. Android, rated 12+.

## Technology

PixelLab's in-house real-time social multiplayer SDK powers every board in 16 Guti and every live room in Adda:

- Server-authoritative game logic (every action validated on the server)
- Queue-based matchmaking into synced rooms
- Reconnect and resync mid-match
- Live streaming that holds up on weak connections

Stack: Colyseus, Socket.io, PlayFab, TypeScript, Railway, PostgreSQL, Firebase.
